title: How Does Red Bull Sell 14 Billion Cans a Year?
description:
Why does Red Bull sell almost 14 billion cans a year?

Sources:
- Red Bull: Company profile (company facts, 2025): https://www.redbull.com/int-en/energydrink/company-profile
- Wikipedia: Red Bull GmbH: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Bull_GmbH
- Wikipedia: Red Bull: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Bull

From the cited pages: Dietrich Mateschitz found Krating Daeng in Thailand in 1982 and said it cured his jet lag; he and Chaleo Yoovidhya each invested US$500,000 to found Red Bull GmbH in 1984; launched in Austria on April 1 1987; early on it gave free cases to college students and built its brand through extreme sport events; it runs Red Bull Media House and the Red Bull Racing and Racing Bulls teams. 2025: 13.969 billion cans, turnover EUR 12.196 billion, sold in 178 countries. Not financial advice.

loop: So next time you see a big stunt, ask yourself:
cta: Stunts or F1? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: Why does Red Bull sell almost 14 billion cans a year?
In 1982, a businessman tried a Thai drink. Then he teamed up with its maker.
But they didn't just sell a drink. They sold stunts.
Then came two Formula One teams. And a media company.

visual.headline: A media company that sells drinks.
